name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
description: S3 object storage, Lambda function invocations, and EC2 instance management.

actions.name: List S3 Buckets
actions.description: Lists all S3 buckets owned by the authenticated sender.

actions.name: List S3 Objects
actions.description: Lists objects within an S3 bucket with prefix filtering.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Limits the response to keys that begin with the specified prefix

actions.name: List Lambda Functions
actions.description: Returns a list of Lambda functions in the current AWS region.

parameters.name: MaxItems
parameters.description: The maximum number of functions to return

actions.name: Invoke Lambda Function
actions.description: Invokes a specific Lambda function synchronously with a JSON payload.

parameters.name: function_name
parameters.description: The name or ARN of the Lambda function

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: The JSON that you want to provide to your Lambda function as input

actions.name: Describe EC2 Instances
actions.description: Describes the specified EC2 instances or all instances in the account.
